text: Every enquiry gets retyped into a brief by hand. Then chased for whatever's missing. That's hours, every week.
So we built the Enquiry-to-Viewing Desk.
It reads the email, the call or the web form, and builds the brief. And where something's unclear, it says so.
It drafts the one question that matters, and when she replies, the answer goes straight into the brief.
Confirm it, and the search starts from the right brief.
That's around six hours a week back for every broker, spent on viewings instead.
